guidance_limits: No universal NHS AI-use rule established; employer instructions control the workflow.
5,000 characters is the NHSBSA illustrated evidence-box limit, not every employer's limit.
Planner checks and automated validation are not NHS panel scores or exhaustive factual verification.
No visa eligibility or sponsorship is inferred from an NHS employer name; official rules and vacancy confirmation are separate.
